profileManagerEmptyDescription: Choose a provider first, then fill in the model and API key. You can keep multiple providers here and switch between them anytime.
profileManagerReadyDescription: Pick a provider card, then fill in the connection details below. Leaving the API key blank during edit keeps the current secret.
providerSelectionHint: Choose the provider that best matches how you bought or access the model. Each option explains who it is for and how the endpoint works.
providerEndpointOfficial: Official endpoint is built in. No custom API endpoint needed.
providerEndpointAzureResource: Enter your Azure resource endpoint. The deployment name is required instead of the base model name.
providerEndpointCustomRequired: A custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint is required.
providerEndpointCustomOptional: The default compatible endpoint is prefilled. Replace it only if your account uses another regional endpoint.
providerOpenaiDescription: Official OpenAI API for GPT models.
providerOpenaiAudience: Best if you use OpenAI directly and want the simplest setup.
providerAzureDescription: OpenAI models served through your Azure subscription.
providerAzureAudience: Best for teams that manage quotas, regions, or compliance inside Azure.
providerDeepseekDescription: Official DeepSeek API for DeepSeek chat and reasoning models.
providerDeepseekAudience: Best if you use DeepSeek directly and want their native pricing and models.
providerGeminiAudience: Best if your models and billing are managed in Google's Gemini ecosystem.
providerAnthropicDescription: Official Anthropic API for Claude models.
providerAnthropicAudience: Best if you want native Claude access without going through another platform.
providerCohereDescription: Official Cohere API for Command models.
providerCohereAudience: Best if your organization already uses Cohere or its Command family.
providerMistralDescription: Official Mistral API using an OpenAI-compatible interface.
providerMistralAudience: Best if you want Mistral-hosted models with a familiar API shape.
providerDashscopeDescription: Alibaba Cloud DashScope for Qwen models with a compatible endpoint.
providerDashscopeAudience: Best if you use Qwen through DashScope and may need a regional endpoint.
providerOpenaiCompatibleDescription: Any provider that exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API.
providerOpenaiCompatibleAudience: Best for third-party gateways, proxy services, or self-hosted compatible endpoints.
